note: Lever 4: intra-document attention masking. Unlike e05/e07/e08 this is not a design imported from a 30B model -- it fixes a measured DEFECT in our own objective. The flat bins carry EOS separators and measured doc lengths are edu 1,008 / finemath 1,505 / code 1,875 tokens, so every block-2048 window really does span 1.4-2.0 documents and every token currently attends across those boundaries. Expect a throughput hit for the same reason e05 took one (explicit mask -> no fused is_causal kernel); the question is whether the CE gain pays for it. This is the arm I most expect to WIN.
